title: Provide support or assistance
description: Offer help, guidance, or hands-on support to someone.
keywords: help, give a hand, support, assist

examples: I can help you with your presentation slides before the meeting.
help you structure and refine your business plan, and create a pitch that will get investors interested.

structures.pattern: give sb a hand with sth
examples: Let me give you a hand with the onboarding checklist this afternoon.

title: Meet follow-up
description: Schedule or confirm a follow-up meeting or next step.
keywords: follow up, check in, touch base, schedule

structures.pattern: follow up with sb on sth
examples: I'll follow up with you on the proposal timeline next Tuesday.

structures.pattern: touch base with sb about sth
examples: Can we touch base with the client about the revised scope?

structures.pattern: schedule a follow-up meeting with sb
examples: Let's schedule a follow-up meeting with the design team after the demo.
